subject: Uptake Health — Sales→CS handoff and 60d activation plan
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, sara.nguyen@uptakehealth.com, luis@uptakehealth.com
Cc: procurement@uptakehealth.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Uptake Health — Sales→CS handoff and 60d activation plan

Team — forwarding the final handoff from Sales for Uptake Health (attached SOW + 60d MAP). Key context below; please read attachments before Monday kickoff.

Deal snapshot (summary for CS):
- ACV: $420k first year (committed Dedicated + Private setup fees).
- Customer: Uptake Health (regional provider of remote patient monitoring). PHI scope: yes — full EHR-derived telemetry.
- Agreed deployment: Redwood Private (VPC) for PHI data, with a Dedicated GPU pool for steady inference throughput and an initial canary to Hosted for non-PHI synthetic testing.
- Model & perf targets: customer requested the finetuned Llama-2-70B variant we vetted; target p95 latency <= 320ms for 512-token responses with batching; throughput target ~60 concurrent sessions (peak).

Primary milestones (60-day MAP attached):
1) Week 0: Procurement + legal signatures (completed; DocuSign link included).
2) Week 1–2: Network readiness (VPC peering, firewall rules, NAT), tenant onboarding, credential exchange.
3) Week 3: Private control plane install & initial Dedicated allocation; smoke tests with synthetic payloads.
4) Week 4–6: Pilot with 2 clinician teams; integrate with their HL7 feed; iterate prompt templates.
5) Week 7–8: Acceptance testing and handover to Customer Success for daily ops.

Proposed internal owners (please confirm / reassign):
- CS Lead / Success owner: Tessa Morgan (primary post-go-live owner)
- Implementation PM: Priyom Das (sprint planning, timeline, client comms)
- Technical lead / infra: Vivek Kulkarni (VPC peering, Dedicated config, perf tuning)
- Sales escalation / exec sponsor: Neha Kapoor (I'll stay on as exec sponsor through Q1)

Risks & open items:
- Network: Uptake requires static IP allowlist and FIPS 140 KMS for keys — Vivek please confirm that Private + KMS integration timeline is realistic within 2 weeks.
- Data volume: They estimate 1.2M tokens/day after ramp — may require larger Dedicated pool; will finalize after pilot telemetry.
- EHR integration: Uptake prefers SFTP HL7 exports; need to validate schema and cadence.

Immediate asks (action items for Monday):
- Vivek: review network-checklist.docx and flag any infra blockers by EOD Mon.
- Priyom: schedule a 60-minute kickoff with Uptake for Tue 4/13 10am PT (propose calendar and agenda).
- Tessa: confirm CS success criteria and acceptance test plan (can use the attached MAP).

Attachments: Uptake_SOW_v2.pdf, Uptake_MAP_60d.xlsx, network-checklist.docx

Thanks team — this is a priority strategic customer for the healthcare vertical.

— Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0199
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sara.nguyen@uptakehealth.com, luis@uptakehealth.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Uptake Health — Sales→CS handoff and 60d activation plan

Thanks Neha — I’ve accepted as CS lead. Quick notes after a first pass on attachments:
- I will draft acceptance criteria this afternoon and share (success metrics, roll-back conditions, SLA definitions).
- I propose the customer-facing kickoff Tue 4/13 10am PT as Priyom suggested; hold that time while Priyom sends calendar invite.
- For go/no-go at Week 3 we should require: (a) VPC peering validated, (b) Dedicated pool green for baseline load, (c) first full end-to-end synthetic test with 512 tokens.

Owner assignments confirmed: Tessa = success metrics & STG→prod acceptance; Priyom = schedule & timeline; Vivek = infra & perf. I’ll add a 'customer readiness' section to the MAP with daily checkpoints.

One ask for Sales: can you confirm whether Uptake intends to route PHI traffic through our on-prem option later this year? That affects retention and audit log strategy.

— Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
Tessa.Morgan@redwoodinference.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sara.nguyen@uptakehealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Uptake Health — Sales→CS handoff and 60d activation plan

Tessa / Neha — reviewed network-checklist.docx and sketched the infra plan. A few clarifying tech questions before I mark blockers:
1) KMS / encryption: Uptake asked for FIPS 140-2 HSM-backed keys. We support KMS integrations via customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS or HSM) in Private. Need the procurement team to confirm timeline for KMS provisioning and whether they want HSM in first phase.
2) IP and ports: we need static egress IPs for the Dedicated pool; procurement should accept a 2-business-day lead for firewall rule prep. Also need to confirm whether they allow 443 only or additional ports for metrics ingestion (we prefer 443 + 8443 for agent telemetry).
3) Data ingestion cadence & size: their estimate of 1.2M tokens/day implies sustained batch size — if that's accurate we'll plan for an initial Dedicated of 4x A100-equivalent nodes and autoscale policy to +50% for peak. Can someone confirm final expected concurrency and average tokens per request?

I'll annotate the network checklist with exact IPs and a minimal port list by EOD Mon. If procurement can confirm KMS and firewall SLAs, we should be on schedule for Week 2 network readiness.

— Vivek
Staff Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, sara.nguyen@uptakehealth.com, procurement@uptakehealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Uptake Health — Sales→CS handoff and 60d activation plan

Following up — procurement at Uptake has confirmed DocuSign was received and signed (see DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/unsigned/RWI-2027-0456). Sara / Luis — thanks, finance will start the billing setup; please expect emails from billing@redwoodinference.com this week.

Action updates: Priyom will send the Tue kickoff invite; Vivek will post annotated network checklist and static IPs by EOD; Tessa will share acceptance criteria doc by 5pm PT Monday. If there are any compliance questions (SOC2 logs, audit retention), loop in security@redwoodinference.com — I’ve copied them on the SFDC deal record.

Thanks everyone — excited to get Uptake operational.

— Neha
